paragraphs.text: Capybara is a creature type , used on cards that depict a species of large, highly social semiaquatic rodents that inhabit savannas and dense forests.
Capybara as a type was introduced in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan for Basking Capybara . They are known to inhabit Ixalan .

Nelli , an Oltec didact, has the belief that even the Oltec's most learned philosophers could only hope to approach the inner serenity of the humble capybara. A spell once massively increased the size of a Capybara on top of one of the Oltec's temples, wrecking its roof, to which Kusi , an Oltec gardener, commented that it was due to be replaced anyways.
